 Coram:

THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ADITYA KUMAR  MOHAPATRA  ORDER 12.12.2024 Order No.
01. 1.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).

2. Heard learned counsel for the Appellant.
3.

Since the Appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code, notice is required to be sent to the informant before admission of the appeal.
Accordingly issue notice to the Respondent.

4. Since a copy of the appeal memo has already been served on the learned counsel appearing for the State, no extra copy of the appeal memo is required to be served on him.
5. Notice be issued to the informant by registered post with A.D. fixing a short returnable date.
Requisites for issue of notice to the informant be filed within three working days.
6. List this matter immediately after receipt of service of notice on the informant.

( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge RKS Location: High Court of Orissa Tanmay Dhopal @ Dhupal vs State Of Odisha on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172933704/
